title: MailFolder
description: A mail folder in a user's mailbox, such as Inbox and Drafts. Mail folders can contain messages, other Outlook items, and child mail folders.

id.description: The unique identifier of the mail folder. Read-only.

parentFolderId.description: The unique identifier for the parent mail folder.

childFolderCount.description: The number of immediate child mail folders in the current folder.

unreadItemCount.description: The number of items marked as unread in the folder.

totalItemCount.description: The number of items in the folder.

isHidden.description: Indicates whether the mail folder is hidden. Can only be set when creating the folder.
